findings.text: the rev= header names 79a17c07, but that revision cannot have produced this log — tests/test_mcp_vocabulary_is_complete.py is new in 3fc05501 and absent at 79a17c07 — so the red log names no tree a later reader can check, even though its substance is right: reinstating the same removal in a scratch copy of the head reddens the same two tests.

the landed entry pushes the schema response past its 24 KiB budget, so this change turns that test red; one instrument measures base at 24520 bytes (56 under the ceiling) and head at 24700 (124 over), and the node reported this as a follow-on it could not repair inside its fence.

the docstring calls the section selector "its positional ``section`` argument" while the MCP tool schema passes every argument by name, so an agent reading it may look for a positional form the surface does not offer.
